lesson-intro.text: Fortune tellers gaze into one of these to see what's coming. It's a big round ball with a swirl and three stars, on a little golden stand. Watch it come into focus, then read your own future.

ball.text: The crystal ball is a big circle. From the top, round down each side to where the stand begins.

cup.text: A cup holds the ball: one curved line across, then a bowl shape below it.

base.text: Under the cup, a short collar, then a wide flat base with rounded ends.

feet.text: Three feet stand under the base. The outer two curl out like hooks, the middle one ends in a knob.

swirl.text: Now the swirl: one line that winds out from the middle of the ball.

stars.text: Three stars float around the swirl: a big one, a middle one and a small one.

gold.text: The cup, the base and the stars are gold.

orange.text: Color the collar and the feet orange.

lesson-outro.text: Look deep into your crystal ball. Does it say you'll draw again tomorrow?
